Disable telemetry, tracking & targeted ads
Features.ToolTip: This setting disables telemetry, diagnostic data collection, activity history, app-launch tracking, targeted ads and more. It limits the data that is sent to Microsoft about your device and usage. If you are a Windows Insider, updates may be blocked until optional diagnostic data collection is turned back on.
Features.ApplyText: Disabling telemetry and diagnostic data collection
Features.ApplyUndoText: Enabling telemetry and diagnostic data collection

Features.Label: Disable Windows Error Reporting
Features.ToolTip: Stops Windows from sending crash and error reports to Microsoft. Applications keep working normally, you simply stop uploading crash data.

Features.Label: Disable Microsoft experiments on this device

Features.UndoLabel: Enable Microsoft experiments on this device

Features.Label: Disable LLMNR name resolution
Features.ToolTip: Link-Local Multicast Name Resolution is a fallback used when DNS cannot resolve a name. Attackers on the same network can answer these broadcasts to capture credentials, and it is one of the most common findings in internal security tests. Normal name resolution keeps working through DNS.

Features.Label: Disable Remote Assistance
Features.ToolTip: Turns off Windows Remote Assistance, which lets someone else connect to and control this PC after an invitation. Remote Desktop is a separate feature and is not affected.

Features.Label: Block anonymous enumeration of accounts & shares
Features.ToolTip: Stops unauthenticated users on the network from listing this PC's user accounts and shared folders, a common first step in an attack. Older NAS devices or software that relies on anonymous guest access to shares may stop connecting.
Features.ApplyText: Blocking anonymous enumeration of accounts & shares
Features.UndoLabel: Allow anonymous enumeration of accounts & shares
Features.ApplyUndoText: Allowing anonymous enumeration of accounts & shares

Features.Label: Disable automatic connection to suggested open hotspots

Features.ApplyUndoText: Enabling automatic connection to suggested open hotspots

Features.Label: Disable Windows Connect Now (WPS)

Features.Label: Prevent Windows from reinstalling removed & promoted apps
Features.ToolTip: Windows silently reinstalls promoted apps such as Candy Crush, TikTok and Spotify, and can bring back preinstalled or OEM apps you removed, especially after a feature update. This turns off Microsoft consumer experiences and stops Content Delivery Manager from re-provisioning those apps. The machine-wide policy is fully honoured on Pro, Enterprise and Education; the per-user settings cover Home as well. This does not remove apps by itself, use the app removal options for that.

Features.UndoLabel: Allow Windows to reinstall removed & promoted apps
